authority: Owner-approved supplement to the canonical Decision Ledger

decisions.decision: Use black (#000000) badge text in Light and white (#FFFFFF) in Dark for all shot-style, Dialed In, pending and admin badges. Preserve exact original JSX dark badge fills in both themes and existing defined borders.
decisions.accessibility_note: Raw text/fill pairs sometimes fall short of 4.5:1. Previously proposed halos are superseded by VISUAL-BADGES-CLEAN-03, in favor of crisp lettering with no text effects. No independent WCAG audit is claimed.
preserved: Sensory taste chip colors and behavior
Recommendation calculations and all backend/data/security decisions
decisions.release_hold: Screenshots and owner approval required before Netlify release.

decisions.decision: Remove all badge lettering shadows, halos, strokes, and background overlays in both Light and Dark. Retain plain black text in Light, plain white text in Dark, original JSX dark badge fills in both modes, and distinct solid badge borders.
preserves: No impact on app data, engine, account privacy, or other Locked decisions
decisions.accessibility_note: Some badge text/solid fill combinations have insufficient raw WCAG contrast. Do not imply compliance; investigate legibility alternatives with the owner if needed.
decisions.release_hold: Private visual review only; no Netlify publishing without owner approval.

decisions.amends: VISUAL-BADGES-CLEAN-03 scope expanded from badge lettering to all app text
decisions.decision: Prohibit text shadows, text halos, strokes and text glow throughout the entire app in Light and Dark, including Admin, authentication, rating controls, and any future UI. Remove decorative card and dialog shadows in favor of solid borders and spacing while keeping focus outlines.
preserves: White badge lettering in Dark and black in Light
Accessibility caveat for raw text contrast
All existing business logic, permissions and backend Locked decisions
decisions.implementation_status: Staged on work/visual-refresh-20261015 for repeatable synthetic screenshot review.
decisions.release_hold: Do not deploy to Netlify or remove SSO until owner authorizes release.

decisions.amends: VISUAL-BADGES-THEME-TEXT-02 color choice and VISUAL-BADGES-CLEAN-03 badge outline treatment only
decisions.decision: Use original dark-JSX badge fills in both modes, uniform black (#000000) text in both modes, and flat borderless pill shapes closer to the original app. Maintain no text shadows, haloes or glyph effects. Non-badge cards, fields and sections retain the approved clear borders.
decisions.accessibility_note: Deep blue fill with black letters can fall below WCAG AA contrast; separate owner-led refinement may be required.
decisions.implementation_status: Staged for synthetic screenshot review; not published.

decisions.amends: New Coffee form grouping visual only
decisions.decision: Remove Optional Coffee Details heading, disclosure and divider. Keep all existing New Coffee inputs in one continuous form and retain existing two-column six-field grid plus full-width Tasting Notes.
decisions.release_hold: Review screenshots only; no Netlify publishing.

decisions.decision: Use the exact original dark-JSX flat badge palette in Light and Dark. Use crisp white ink for Ristretto and Traditional; crisp black ink for Turbo, Custom, Lungo, Dialed In and mapped gold statuses. Do not add badge or text shadows, glyph effects or borders.
decisions.source: Original project dial-in-collective.jsx STYLE_BADGE mapping and owner-approved side-by-side HTML.

decisions.decision: Restore original JSX Shot History density: single-line shot summary on wider viewports, numeric US M/D/YYYY date at right, style/status badges, collapsed notes and visible Edit link. Responsive phone layout may put date on next line. Setup/basket/feed only at bottom when expanded; add per-coffee contextual Expand All / Collapse All. Preserve historic measurements, context and Make Current Recipe separation.
Remove redundant reason 'Based on your successful shots in this recipe family.' from successful windows; only retain meaningful explanatory copy and specific measured advice.

Keep Section 25.2 eight-tier recommendation evidence hierarchy, with personal successful exact coffee/setup/style first and own grinder calibration prioritized for grind. Do not silently claim unimplemented community/similarity evidence sources. Specific next-shot targets should be evidence-based and never fabricated; distinguish a generic roast/style starting baseline from proven exact-coffee personal history.
decisions.implementation_status: UI reconciliation in progress; full evidence-tier audit/integration remains an explicit work item, not complete.
decisions.release_hold: All work private branch; no Netlify release without owner approval.

decisions.amends: Implements existing Master Specification Section 25.2 tier 5; not a change to tier ordering
decisions.decision: For unproven coffee ratio/time, lightly blend personal successful same-setup/style/feed and same-roast similar-coffee evidence, favoring shared process/origin/variety and basket. Keep exact successful personal history above this tier. Attribute real counts/provenance; never invent community participation or silently transfer unknown feed.
decisions.release_hold: Private review branch, no Netlify release.
decisions.remaining_work: Exact coffee community, related releases, similar community and robust contributor-balanced aggregation remain unimplemented and must not be represented as production-ready.
